c74object.name: el.granule~
c74object.description:
el.granule~ is a polyphonic stereo granular synthesis instrument that draws from two mono buffers: a waveform buffer (sound source) and an envelope buffer (grain window). It can generate dense, stochastic clouds of up to 512 simultaneous grains via spray and pitchspray, or schedule individual deterministic grains via grain. Double-clicking the object opens inspection windows for both assigned buffers.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (messages): Control inlet. Accepts all synthesis commands, grain triggers (spray, pitchspray, grain), and parameter updates (grist, setscale, setbuf, etc.).
Outlets
Outlet 1 [Left Outlet] (signal): Left audio channel output.
Outlet 2 [Right Outlet] (signal): Right audio channel output.

inlet.description: Receives messages to configure synthesis boundaries, define pitch scales, and trigger grains or clouds.

outlet.description: Left channel of the synthesized granular texture.
Right channel of the synthesized granular texture.

objarg.name: waveform-buffer
objarg.description: Required. The name of the single-channel (mono) buffer~ containing the grain waveform.

objarg.name: envelope-buffer
objarg.description: Required. The name of the single-channel (mono) buffer~ containing the grain envelope window.

method.name: constrain_scale
method.description: When set to 1, forces scale selection in pitchspray to conform to the minimum and maximum frequency limits set in grist. When set to 0 (default), the entire scale range is used.

method.name: events
method.description: Sets the number of grains generated on each call to spray or pitchspray.

method.name: grain
method.description: Deploys a single grain with explicit parameters as a 4-element list: [duration_ms, frequency_hz, amplitude, pan]. Pan ranges from 0.0 (left) to 1.0 (right). Audio processing must be running to receive this message.

method.name: grist
method.description:
Sets parameters for spray and pitchspray using a 10-element list:
• events: Number of grains generated per trigger.
• horizon_ms: Time window (in milliseconds) across which grains are distributed.
• minfreq / maxfreq: Minimum and maximum frequency bounds (Hz).
• minpan / maxpan: Stereo panning range (0.0 = left, 1.0 = right).
• minamp / maxamp: Grain peak amplitude range.
• mindur_ms / maxdur_ms: Grain duration range (milliseconds).

method.name: highblock
method.description: Sets a hard high-frequency ceiling in Hertz. Any grain calculated above this frequency is aborted.

method.name: info
method.description: Prints the number of currently active grains and assigned buffer names to the Max Console.

method.name: lowblock
method.description: Sets a hard low-frequency floor in Hertz. Any grain calculated below this frequency is aborted.

method.name: mute
method.description: When set to 1, mutes DSP computation and outputs silence. 0 restores active synthesis.

method.name: pitchdev
method.digest: Set random pitch deviation for scale
method.description: Sets the random pitch deviation multiplier applied to scale frequencies during pitchspray. Accepts non-negative values (typically 0.0 to 1.0).

method.name: pitchspray
method.description: Triggers a cloud of grains distributed according to the parameters set in grist, with frequencies quantized to the active pitch scale defined by setscale.

method.name: setbuf
method.description: Changes the source waveform buffer and grain envelope window buffer. Both buffers must be single-channel (mono).

method.name: setscale
method.description: Defines the pitch scale as a series of frequencies in Hertz (requires at least 2 frequencies, up to 8192).

method.name: spray
method.description: Triggers a cloud of grains distributed according to the parameters set in grist, with random frequencies chosen continuously between minfreq and maxfreq.

method.name: steady
method.description: When set to 1, grain start times are evenly spaced across the horizon window (horizon / events). When set to 0 (default), grain onset delays are distributed randomly.

method.name: transpose
method.description: Master frequency multiplier applied to all grains regardless of scale or random settings (default: 1.0).
